rows.shows: Volume bar with number 0-100 and source icon (speaker, headphones, BT, WiSA, WOWCAST); muted icon; audiod itself only toasts 'Wired Headphones connected.'
rows.trigger: Volume/mute key; audioService plugin; config com.webos.surfacemanager.volumeOSD (default true), disableMuteAnimation…
rows.evidence: WebOSCompositor/views/StarfishVolumeView.qml, volume/StarfishVolume.qml, StarfishVolumeMute.qml; audiod scan

rows.id: Q(k) Screen saver and screen-off hand-offs (tvpowerd)
rows.name: Screen Saver power state
rows.shows: Launches flutter app com.webos.app.screensaver (window type screenSaver) or web container com.webos.app.videoads…
rows.trigger: tvpowerd turnOnScreenSaver; ignored on OLED/LCD models with 'Screen Saver Off' [INFERENCE]; Always On/Ready timers…
rows.evidence: tvpowerd symbols ScreenSaverLaunch, RequestScreenSaver; rdxd/sleepd 0 notification hits; screensaver/videoads appinfo.json

findings: Funnel: every service calls luna com.webos.notification (served by /usr/sbin/notificationmgr; also notificationhistory, closeAllAlerts, callback/wakeUp). Types: createToast, createAlert, createInputAlert (only eim, asm, irdbmanager-style input popups), createPincodePrompt (appinstalld, dmost, sam, HbbtvPlugins/libHbbtv2Plugin.so). Rendering these 4 types in the compositor covers ~all service rows.

Alert buttons carry luna URIs: each button has onclick (uri+params) plus onclose, e.g. secondscreen.gateway pairing-manager.js -> palm://com.webos.service.secondscreen.gateway/pairing/acceptPairing; compositor KeyFilters/appLaunch.js:3628 -> luna://com.webos.service.tvpower/power2/powerOff. A replacement renderer must call these URIs; results are not returned in the createAlert response.

SSAP pairing (matters for Home Assistant webostv): secondscreen.gateway raises a modal createAlert, types PROMPT (Yes/No), PIN (PIN as title, Cancel), COMBINED, LGSWITCH-PIN; it wakes the screen first via com.webos.service.tvpower/power/turnOnScreen; full-page PIN popup is a separate path (allowFullPagePopup, drawn by another component, not by notification).

Strings gap: 16 services ship cstrings.json, not cppstrings.json, so they are missing from /tmp/service_strings.txt (airplay, appcasting, bluetooth-audio-source, bnoproxyservice, bthidmanager, rdp, google-home-controller, irdbmanager, legacy-broadcast-atsc/dvb 783 keys each, miracast, mrcu 71, multiviewcontroller 85, voice-framework-extension 274, update 59, wisa-manager). English keys saved at /tmp/SurfaceAudit.ServiceSurfaces/cstrings_en.txt (source /mnt/lg/wee/ui_l10n/usr/share/localization/<svc>/resources/de/cstrings.json). mrcu has no own binary: it lives in /usr/sbin/lginput2.

legacy-broadcast-atsc/dvb (TV engine, 783 strings): update messages, EAS ('Emergency alert message has arrived.'), timer power-off, 3D, picture-value toasts ('Backlight : {pszValue}', 'Screen Mute : On'), recording errors, CI module. Its notification calls were NOT scanned (TV scan stopped on request); they only matter with a tuner pipeline active. Antenna rarely used here.

No UI at all (0 notification/launch hits or helper-only): rdxd (telemetry reporter, com.webos.rdxd), sleepd, avmutemanager, iot-proxy, lowlevelstorage, systemprofile, sysfaultdetector, lim, bam, servicemanager, uploadd, mfi, snapshot-boot-manager, activitymanager, logoutd, audiooutputd, tcpd, devicereset, network-input-service, color-info-miner, ledbarcontroller, btgattwowcast, hbbtv2-mediasync, camera2/microphone services; voiceinput and flutter-wayland-client have no createX calls.

Dormant/unlikely on this set: rollingscreen (roller/flex models), buddyconnector/KakaoTalk (Korea), signlanguage-avatar (menu language Korean only), HbbTV/hybridtv/Ginga (HbbTV off), wasu-policy-manager/dangbei-adapter (China), yandex.alice.adapter (Russia), wisa-manager/bnoproxyservice (WiSA/B&O hardware), US EAS only on tuner input, admanager prompts depend on blocked ad hosts, fancontroller only on fault.

Screen-off/screen saver: tvpowerd owns power states (Active, Active Standby, Screen Saver, Always On Display, Always Ready, ForcedOffTimer). It launches com.webos.app.screensaver (flutter, window type screenSaver) and com.webos.app.videoads (web, screenSaver window); luna turnOnScreenSaver, turnOnScreen/turnOffScreen. screenmanager and starfish-media-pipeline also reference videoads.

Compositor draws its own UI beyond service alerts: volume/mute OSD (WebOSCompositor/views/StarfishVolumeView.qml + volume/*, data from libaudioserviceplugin.so), and KeyFilters/appLaunch.js raises createAlert itself (power-key related alerts; the Battery Saver alert needs a battery profile, not on this TV).
